findings.evidenceJa: その善悪を見極めなくては
findings.governingReading: その善悪を見極める explicitly names moral character as the purpose of finding Lancer’s unseen Master.
findings.explanation: Judging a Master’s good or evil becomes determining intent.

findings.governingReading: 一昨日 dates the earlier patrol policy two days back.
findings.explanation: The day before yesterday becomes yesterday.

findings.highlight: I'll act helpless until we lure out an enemy.
findings.evidenceJa: 敵の気配を察するまでは無関心を装おう
findings.governingReading: 敵の気配を察するまでは無関心を装う keeps a collective indifferent appearance until detecting enemy presence.
findings.explanation: Feigning indifference until sensing an enemy becomes feigning helplessness to lure one out.

findings.highlight: There are just fewer people out than usual.
findings.evidenceJa: 人通りが途絶えているだけだ
findings.governingReading: 人通りが途絶えている says traffic has stopped, matching the deserted station and terminal.
findings.explanation: Pedestrian traffic having ceased becomes merely fewer people than usual.
